Lemma
[Tangential integration by parts]1. ch16:16.1\group chapter-16 For $g\in C^1_0(\mathcal U)$ and area element $dA$ on $\mathcal G$, egin{equation} ag {16.10} \int _{\mathcal G}\delta g\, dA=-n\int _{\mathcal G}gH u \, dA. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch On a graph, set $v=\sqrt{1+|Du|^2}$ and use $ u _i=-D_i u/v$, $dA=v\, dx$, and

egin{equation} ag {16.11} u _{n+1}= rac1v. \end{equation}

Integration by parts gives $\int _{\mathcal G}\delta _i g\, dA=-n\int _{\mathcal G}gH u _i\, dA$ componentwise; a partition of unity gives the general case.

□

Note that the case $i=n+1$ in Lemma 16.1 is equivalent to the integral form of the prescribed mean curvature equation.
